svg.title: Falcon DDT test plan: which layers each stage runs, and what feeds them
svg.text: Falcon FS-AI DDT: test stages over the same five layers
FSDS or a CARLA FS sim
all missions; faults injected: dropped sweeps, late images, a stuck wheel speed
open loop: commands are logged, not sent anywhere
supervisor only: topic rates, latency per stage, timestamp alignment
real CAN cable to our PC
AS states from the organisers' VCU model: ready, driving, finished, emergency brake
missions on the scaled track; the car stops itself if commands stop for 100 ms
first real AS run; steering and speed step responses logged to refit the profile
layer runs and is tested here
Arrows inside a stage are the same data flow as the architecture figure. A stage with no return arrow is open loop. The ADS-DV profile is used everywhere except stage 3.
